Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. major (line 1654): The route fallback never runs. `useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)` is called outside the try block, and in packages/core-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx it is the hook itself that throws `No path for ...` when the route is not mounted. The returned function does not throw. So the card crashes in any app where the notifications page is not mounted, instead of falling back to '/notifications'. This breaks FR-3 and the 'Deep-link href and route fallback' decision, which calls for `useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)()` inside the try. Every card test passes `mountedRoutes`, so the fallback path is never tested. — fix: Put the hook call inside the try: `let root = '/notifications'; try { root = useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)(); } catch { /* page not mounted */ }`. The hook throws only after its own internal hooks have run, so the hook count stays the same. Add a test that renders without `mountedRoutes` and checks that the 'View all notifications' link points to '/notifications'.
